claims.proposed_claim: The repository implements source/provenance, human-review and operation-specific preflight contracts.
mandatory_limitations: Local code and constructed validation, not accepted genuine services or actual source authorization

claims.proposed_claim: Mission28 selected resource-free acceptance passed 3614 cases with 118 protected dependencies unexecuted.
mandatory_limitations: Exact baseline receipt scope; never a detection score, an experiment or whole-repository acceptance

claims.proposed_claim: The documentary plan contains 23 train, 3 control and 1 engine candidate at crossing_A, plus excluded duplicate references.
mandatory_limitations: No verified physical identity, availability, ownership or formal inventory signoff

claims.proposed_claim: Legacy reported still-image mAP50=.9946 and mAP50:95=.855 describe a leakage-flagged development_fallback split.
mandatory_limitations: Reported 487 objects are not train events; no new reproduction or event/cross-site inference

claims.proposed_claim: Legacy reports contain F1=.869 and AUC=.961 at .3700; split labels and detailed precision differ.
mandatory_limitations: Checkpoint is configuration-declared only; preserve validation/test/window/recording distinctions; not event protection

claims.proposed_claim: The system has validated event-level train detection performance.
mandatory_limitations: No genuine source/GT/authorized evaluation; exclude positive performance assertion

claims.proposed_claim: Primary analysis retains independent camera clocks; front approach and back clearance outcomes remain separate.
mandatory_limitations: Methodology direction only; old front-only draft is not a replacement; no camera performance validated

claims.proposed_claim: Front/rear/side appearance classes validate train direction.
mandatory_limitations: View labels are not validated direction truth

claims.proposed_claim: The system is robust in all weather.
mandatory_limitations: No controlled weather evaluation; confuser categories are not field-weather validation

claims.proposed_claim: Night performance has been established.
mandatory_limitations: Night/zero-night documentary conflict unresolved; no inspected source or authorized stratified evaluation

claims.proposed_claim: Fog and rain detection performance is demonstrated.
mandatory_limitations: ESC-50 rain/audio category does not establish real crossing performance under rain/fog

claims.proposed_claim: Restricted R04 fusion remains exploratory for exactly eleven events, with no event010 expansion.
mandatory_limitations: No fresh alignment, fusion improvement or primary/generalization claim; acoustic offsets do not shift GT

claims.proposed_claim: Audio is supporting evidence only and cannot independently authorize lowering or clearance under the adopted policy.
mandatory_limitations: Policy role, not proof of field horn accuracy or hardware safety

claims.proposed_claim: Real-data premature opening was measured as zero.
mandatory_limitations: Non-evaluable/null is not measured zero; missing approved T4 and authorization

claims.proposed_claim: M4 is primary, M5 is an integer NEVER_PROTECTED_M5 companion, and MTR is a feasibility screen with metric-specific eligibility.
mandatory_limitations: Sampled software contracts are not continuous physical safety proof; no new numerical cutoff or global exclusion

claims.proposed_claim: Full roadway occupancy has been validated or calculated.
mandatory_limitations: Physical entry and same-camera/synchronization requirements remain deferred

claims.proposed_claim: Legacy lens-plane or road-centerline labels are validated physical T2.
mandatory_limitations: T2 remains physical-roadway-entry deferred; no invented exit landmark

claims.proposed_claim: Historical timing or unit tests establish real-time field operation.
mandatory_limitations: No real-time field latency measurement or deployment acceptance; simulated convention is not hardware response

claims.proposed_claim: The implementation improves railway safety.
mandatory_limitations: Engineering refusals/tests do not measure safety benefit or certification

claims.proposed_claim: The system generalizes to other crossings.
mandatory_limitations: Single fixed crossing; development leakage and no multi-site independent evaluation

claims.proposed_claim: The human review procedure has demonstrated annotation accuracy.
mandatory_limitations: No actual appointed/qualified reviewers or independent human observations; no inferred agreement/tolerance

claims.proposed_claim: Declared checkpoint hashes and Git presence guarantee scientific reproducibility.
mandatory_limitations: Configuration declarations and code presence do not prove actual assets, rights, source lineage, GT or repeated experiments

claims.proposed_claim: The workflow distinguishes submission, verification, purpose acceptance, preflight, authorization and execution.
mandatory_limitations: Cooperative software behavior; no OS isolation, genuine deployment or institutional approval established

claims.proposed_claim: Dataset/model documentation can describe intended use, provenance and limitations without converting a reference into project permission.
mandatory_limitations: Primary literature is conceptual context, not verification of this project or evidence of novelty
